title: How To Create A Newsletter Template
text:
## How To Create A Newsletter Template
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000004623
This article explains how to create a newsletter template from the Emails >> Send Newsletter section of the admin area.
Newsletter templates can also be created from Emails >> Email Templates , but this article focuses on creating one directly from the newsletter builder.

## Where to Start
Go to Emails >> Send Newsletter .
Click the New Email Newsletter button.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181469771/original/9MAvZanP2vhkOLRjosgtWIx9MPwMwHCzCw.png?1783117687 | alt: ]
The first step is to give the newsletter a name and choose how the newsletter should be created.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181469822/original/dsTDKx0LdzijbKTOz7P3HlxsXXjwUcNlbA.png?1783117820 | alt: ]
There are three available options:
Start Blank
AI Generate
Select Template

## Option 1: Start Blank
Selecting Start Blank opens the standard newsletter editor.
This option is best when the newsletter will be created manually from scratch.
Enter a name for the newsletter.
Select Start Blank .
Click Continue .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181469851/original/uKT1eUqqi-Hu5nrcXywmmurhrXvnR9w-WQ.png?1783117899 | alt: ]
The admin will be taken to the newsletter editor, where the newsletter content can be added, edited, saved, and sent.

## Option 2: AI Generate
Selecting AI Generate opens the Quick Create Wizard, which helps generate a newsletter using AI. This option is useful when the admin wants help creating the first draft of the newsletter content.
For complete step-by-step instructions, please see the following article:
Quick Create Wizard - Create Newsletter
The Quick Create Wizard allows the admin to:
Add a custom prompt for the newsletter
Select options for format, tone, audience, length, images, and color mood
Use suggested prompts as a starting point
Review and edit the generated newsletter before saving
Continue to the standard newsletter editor to make final changes or send the newsletter

## Option 3: Select Template
Selecting Select Template allows the admin to create a newsletter from an existing saved newsletter template. This option is best when the site already has newsletter templates saved and one of those templates should be reused.
Enter a name for the newsletter.
Select Select Template .
Choose one of the available saved newsletter templates.
Click Continue .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181469901/original/yvQLuna6FLtLN4sX1iKpW0Ke6bRHh1_0Pw.png?1783118131 | alt: ]
The selected template will open in the standard newsletter editor, where the content can be edited and sent.
